purpose: Default bounded execution loop for humans and coding/agent models. Preserve exact source identity, expose one small lawful move, verify consequence, return evidence, then release authority and replan.
short: What exactly? → Hold one thing → Make one bounded move → Prove what changed → Write what came back.
invariants: One loop carries one addressed object/focus. Projection changes do not create a new object.
At most three lawful native moves may be exposed while HOLD is active.
TURN means one bounded native move. If that move has EFFECT authority, an explicit host-native RELEASE/commit gate is required before dispatch.
TRACE records observation/evidence only; it never creates permission, priority, identity or authority.
RETURN closes the move. No second move inherits authority from the first.
PASS requires executed checks. Missing human/device/world evidence is INDETERMINATE/UNKNOWN, not PASS.
If a stage cannot satisfy its exit condition, STOP and name the missing condition. Do not forage for substitute work.

stages.question: What exact thing are we acting on?
entry: A request, signal, issue, object or returned residue exists.
No exact canonical object/focus is yet fixed for this move, OR a prior RETURN requires fresh replanning.
operation: Resolve the authoritative owner and exact address/version/ref.
Separate source facts from derived interpretation.
Record only the source refs needed to recover the object.
exit: Exactly one primary object/focus is named.
If authority/source cannot be resolved, exit STOP_UNKNOWN rather than guessing.
stages.example: Stale architecture-map report → source /nexus/map.html at its current blob SHA; owner is 0xxx0/0xxx0.github.io; /control/CURRENT.json and showcase-manifest.json are supporting sources, not substitute authority.

stages.question: What are we holding constant while we act?
entry: SOURCE exited with an exact object/focus and owner.
Inspection/read access for the intended move is lawful.
operation: Freeze object id/address, current focus, objective, constraints and RETURN address.
Name the stop rule and any required commit/release boundary.
exit: Object/focus can be re-identified after interruption.
The allowed move set and authority boundary are explicit.
RETURN address is known before action.
stages.example: Hold the current system-map object; objective = make its architecture current; allowed moves = edit map, verify map, return evidence; stop if the current root/manifest authority disagrees.

stages.question: What is the one bounded move?
entry: One supported native move has been selected.
operation: Preview declared consequence and reversibility when available.
Perform one bounded native operation only.
For VIEW/NAVIGATION/OFFER moves, TURN may complete directly.
For EFFECT moves, cross an explicit host-native RELEASE/commit boundary; the carrier/protocol itself never dispatches effects.
exit: The native operation was attempted once and produced a result handle, changed artifact, commit/ref, or explicit failure.
No unrelated second move was started.
If the move was unsupported or authority was absent, exit STOP_UNSUPPORTED.
stages.example: Patch the existing architecture map and its exact navigation/manifest references as one bounded repo change set; do not use the same authority to start a second redesign.

stages.question: What actually happened?
entry: TURN produced an attempted result or explicit failure.
operation: Run machine-verifiable checks first: syntax, invariant/unit tests, replay/fixtures, responsive/browser smoke, route/link checks, diff/roundtrip as applicable.
Record PASS, FAIL or INDETERMINATE per claim.
Separate repository/software proof from real-device, human, physical or social evidence.
exit: Every material claim has an evidence ref or is explicitly UNKNOWN/INDETERMINATE.
Observed consequence is distinguishable from forecast/intention.
Failure is preserved rather than rewritten as success.
stages.example: Static parse confirms one HTML/SVG document and all 11 requested nodes; committed root link + manifest entry are re-read successfully; live browser rendering remains INDETERMINATE if no browser/CI run is available.

stages.question: What came back, and what is now reusable?
operation: Write durable before → after delta, evidence refs, residue/lesson and unresolved unknowns.
Record the exact object/result identity needed for re-entry.
Set next = NONE unless a new SOURCE/HOLD cycle explicitly replans.
exit: A durable receipt or equivalent evidence object exists.
The loop is closed and resumable from source + evidence.
No next action is implied by completion alone.
stages.example: Write /returns/SYSTEM_MAP_CONVERGENCE_2026-10-02.json with before/after/evidence/residue; then stop. Any further architecture work begins again at SOURCE.

outcome.rule: RETURNED means the bounded loop closed with durable evidence; it does not mean the domain is solved.

agent_contract.use_when: Any coding, repo, design, research, planning or world-facing task that can be reduced to one addressed object and one bounded move.
prohibitions: Do not infer authority from route, projection, chat, branch, score or prior success.
Do not call an effect TURN-only; EFFECT requires explicit native RELEASE/commit.
Do not substitute receipt-writing for a useful change.
Do not claim human/device/world proof from synthetic or repository checks.
Do not continue into a second move without a fresh SOURCE/HOLD.
agent_contract.stop_rule: If the highest-value next step is genuinely human/world gated, perform at most one directly-related preparatory fallback, RETURN it, then STOP with the exact gate.
